coordinate_reference: SVG viewBox x/y pixels (1920 x 1240), not geographic coordinates.

halls_of_residence.source_consistency_note: The official Hall of Residence overview says there are four halls (Ganga, Mahanadi, Brahmaputra, Subarnarekha) with capacity about 2,000; the same page's contact list also names Rushikulya and Sangam HR. The Students Life page has a different/older count and mentions A.N. Khosla Hall outside the permanent campus. Because public pages are internally inconsistent, this map lists the names but only pins MHR, BHR and RHR where they appear on the supplied campus road map. Verify any exact operational roster with the institute.

limitations: Map positions are schematic translations of the supplied Road Map IIT BBS image, not surveyed coordinates.
The broad 2025 master-plan development categories are represented in the legend, not as georeferenced polygons.
The 2023 infrastructure plan distinguishes existing and proposed works; proposed projects are not represented as completed.
No network switch positions, cable routes, IP addressing, or production network relationships are known from these campus maps.
Nescafé and Community Centre labels are retained from the supplied road map; their current operating status was not independently verified.
The 2023 plan lists several additional areas and future projects, but exact current building status/position requires institute confirmation.
